crossRefs.note: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless…
Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and the people that you have brought up out of the land of Egypt…

translations.web: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
